hardware: CPU only — Intel Iris Xe, no CUDA
method: linear system from 3-token and 20-token measured runs
note: TTFT covers tokenization + prefill (one fwd pass over all 40 layers for the input tokens). TPOT is one fwd pass per output token — AirLLM reloads all layers from disk for every decode step because KV cache is not kept in RAM between tokens.
